name: C and O Farms
description: C and O Farms grows Strawberries, Blueberries, Raspberries, Blackberries, and Apples in 480 Wilkies Grove Church Road, NC. The farm is small, and its seasons run through spring, summer, and autumn. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Apr – Jun in this growing zone.
